scope: Test-only HTTP framing fix, no production authorization, response limits, service deadlines or execution authority changed.

original_failures.cause: Root chose a long private TMPDIR exceeding macOS Unix socket pathname limit; setup corrected with short private /private/tmp/adm.* scratch.

original_failures.observed: Full Rust run failed one native authorization test on ConnectionReset during read_to_string after sending a POST.
original_failures.limits: 20 standalone repeats with diagnostic-only instrumentation all passed; no original reset response bytes were captured. Full-suite failure is preserved. The existing native_commands test helper already uses framed completion.

regression: A complete Content-Length denial followed by ConnectionReset deterministically fails the former EOF-based read and succeeds through framed completion. Truncated header/body, duplicate or missing Content-Length, transfer encoding, signed and overflow lengths remain failures.

qualification.full_local_matrix: Runs after the repaired source is committed; scoped pass does not claim full or hosted CI success.
